title: Ukraine sends interceptor drones and experts to protect US bases in Jordan
body:
On 9 March 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said in an interview with the New York Times that Ukraine had deployed interceptor drones and a team of specialists to help protect United States military bases in Jordan. He said the United States had requested the help on 5 March and that Ukraine agreed and sent the team the next day. Zelensky said: "We reacted immediately."

The request came amid regional escalation that began on 28 February 2026, when the United States and Israel launched coordinated strikes on Iran's military infrastructure and leadership. Iran responded with drones and missiles against US bases, diplomatic facilities and civilian targets across the region.

Zelensky said Ukraine had received 11 requests from countries neighbouring Iran, several European states and the United States, covering interceptor technology, electronic warfare systems and training, and that Ukraine had already responded to some of them. The Washington Post reported on 6 March that Moscow had been giving Iran intelligence on US military positions, including ships and aircraft. US President Donald Trump downplayed that report on 7 March. Russia condemned the US and Israeli strikes on Iran.
